page.title: Integrations
page.subtitle: Connect a platform to receive the morning staffing digest each day.

slack.blurb: Post the morning digest to a Slack channel.
slack.guide: Create an Incoming Webhook in your Slack workspace and paste the URL below. The digest is delivered to that channel each morning.

webhookUrl.label: Incoming webhook URL
webhookUrl.help: Slack → Apps → Incoming Webhooks → Add to channel.

telegram.blurb: Send a daily message via a Telegram bot.
telegram.guide: Talk to @BotFather to create a bot and grab its token, then add the bot to your group/channel and provide the chat ID.

chatId.label: Chat ID
chatId.help: Numeric ID of the user, group, or channel to message.

discord.blurb: Drop the digest into a Discord channel.
discord.guide: In your Discord server: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook, then copy the webhook URL.

whatsapp.blurb: Deliver the digest over WhatsApp Business.
whatsapp.guide: Use a WhatsApp Business Cloud API number. Provide your phone number ID and a permanent access token.

recipient.label: Recipient number
recipient.help: Number that receives the morning digest (E.164 format).

zalo.blurb: Notify a Zalo user/group via the zca-js sidecar.
zalo.guide: Zalo gửi qua tài khoản cá nhân (zca-js sidecar). Bấm “Đăng nhập QR” bên dưới rồi quét mã bằng app Zalo của tài khoản gửi — không cần chạy lệnh nào. Sau đó nhập threadId người/nhóm nhận. (Cần sidecar backend/zalo_sidecar đang chạy: npm install → npm start.)

recipient.label: Recipient threadId
recipient.help: ID của user (sender có thể nhắn) hoặc nhóm — xem zalo_sidecar/README.md.

threadType.label: Thread type
threadType.help: Để 'user' nếu gửi cho một người, 'group' nếu gửi vào nhóm.

gmail.blurb: Email the digest from a Gmail account.
gmail.guide: Enable 2-Step Verification on the Google account and create an App Password (16 characters). Use it instead of your normal password.

appPassword.label: App password
appPassword.help: 16-char Google App Password — never your real password.

email.blurb: Send via any custom SMTP server.
email.guide: Connect any SMTP provider (SendGrid, Mailgun, your own server) by entering the host, port, and credentials.

zaloLogin.scanHint: Open Zalo on the sender account's phone → scan the code.
zaloLogin.expired: The QR code has expired — tap “QR login” to generate a new one.
zaloLogin.declined: Login was declined on the phone — try again.

toast.savedDesc: The morning digest will be delivered to this channel.
